title: 2112 Prairie, the Rothschild house, built from its map and photograph
items: 2112 Prairie now stands as the Rothschild house instead of a draft box. It has a pale stone front with a canted stone bay at the south end, and a round-arched door at the head of a broad stoop between solid stone cheeks. Over two tall storeys and a high basement rises a slated mansard with two dormers, and a two-storey range stands behind.

Its plan comes from the 1911 fire-insurance map, read at full size: a 14.5 by 11.7 m house, its bay and its rear range. The draft had put the house where the rear range stands. The front's forms come from the early-1890s photograph of the 2100 block, which shows it first on the left.
